correctness.rationale: For unnormalized Laplacian of k triangles sharing one vertex, constants and eigenvalue-1 pair-balanced leaf differences, eigenvalue-3 pair antisymmetry, and eigenvalue-(2k+1) hub-leaf radial mode give complete orthogonal decomposition (multiplicities 1,k-1,k,1). Summing projector kernels, the hub absolute row sum is 4ku, while leaf row sum is the max of 3e^-3t+(k-1)e^-t/k+u/k and 2(k-1)e^-t/k+2u/k. The partner entry sign changes at unique monotone root eta; strict convexity of f(x)=(4k²-1)x^k-3kx-(k-1) gives a unique earlier hub-to-leaf crossing xi. Their transversality yields exactly two corners, with asymptotics tau=(log k)/(2k)+O(log k/k²) and sigma=.5 log3+1/(2k)+O(k^-2). Independently constructed the exact rational projectors from graph Laplacian geometry and checked row norms at z=e^-t=1/2 for k=2,3,4, obtaining 41/64, 91/128, 769/1024 as predicted. Finite checks only corroborate the all-k proof.
